headline: Dighi Port: the largest shipyard in the country at Dighi port
summary: Agreements for what is described as the largest shipyard in the country were signed at Dighi Port in the presence of Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis and Minister Nitesh Rane.
why: Port and shipyard projects expand India's shipbuilding and maritime logistics capacity, which affects port operators, shipbuilders and freight flows.
